next.reason: 1985: 'The MULTIPLE FILE TAPE clause is presented on page VII-16 in the Sequential I-O module.'; 2023: 'FMT-12.4.6.2: I-O-CONTROL . [ [ apply-commit-clause] . ] [ [ { same-clause }… ]. ] — no MULTIPLE FILE TAPE clause'. The 2023 I-O-CONTROL format allows only the APPLY COMMIT and SAME clauses, so the MULTIPLE FILE TAPE clause this rule points to is no longer part of the standard.
